title: The Well of Harrow Glen
author: Edmund Montrose
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
